awarded.title: SolConnector.withdraw uses only gas/value LZ options, no ordered-execution option -> out-of-order delivery -> Solana vault rejects on InvalidInboundNonce while Orderly ledger already debited -> cross-chain balance inconsistency
awarded.label: MISSED
awarded.note: MISS (reasoning gap): I read SolConnector.sol deep and saw withdrawOptions = newOptions().addExecutorLzReceiveOption(gas,value) AND the order_delivery/inbound_nonce gate on both sides, but did not reason that LayerZero requires addExecutorOrderedExecutionOption() on SEND for the receive-side nonce ordering to hold -> without it messages arrive unordered and the nonce==inbound_nonce+1 require! rejects them, desyncing balances. LZ-Solana cross-chain mechanism knowledge gap; new class authored.
